moves.name: Paged KV-cache block tables and write layouts
moves.description: KV cache entries are addressed through slot_mapping and logical block tables, so sequences need not occupy contiguous memory. The original CUDA write path stores keys as [num_blocks, heads, head/x, block, x], while reshape_and_cache_flash writes the NHD/FlashAttention-compatible layout.
moves.problem_solved: Dynamic batching and prefix growth without copying each sequence's KV cache into contiguous buffers.
semantic_preconditions: slot_mapping entries are either negative padding or valid cache slots
block tables cover every logical block in each active sequence
writers and attention backends agree on x-packed versus NHD/flash layout
hardware_preconditions: SIMT warp execution
x packing assumes 16-byte vector-compatible cache elements
framework_preconditions: KV allocator owns block tables and slot_mapping
FlashAttention backends receive block_table metadata for paged cache

assumptions.assumption: slot_mapping is the token-to-cache write authority
original key layout is x-packed by 16-byte vectors

moves.performance_evidence: No isolated cache-write number read; mechanism enables PagedAttention and paged FA/FlashInfer paths.

moves.name: PagedAttention V1 per-(sequence, head) CTA decode
moves.description: One CUDA thread block computes one sequence/head query. Warps stride through paged KV blocks, use warp-level QK reductions, stage FP32 logits in shared memory, then reduce and apply V.
moves.problem_solved: Low-latency single-token decode over non-contiguous paged KV without materializing contiguous K/V.
semantic_preconditions: one query token per sequence in decode
HEAD_SIZE, BLOCK_SIZE and NUM_THREADS match template instantiation
block_tables cover context_len
hardware_preconditions: warp size 32
shared memory sufficient for logits/reduction scratch
framework_preconditions: torch custom op paged_attention_v1 available before PR #47361
PagedAttention wrapper supplies context_lens and block_tables

assumptions.assumption: CTA grid maps head and sequence

moves.name: PagedAttention V2 split-KV with max/exp reduction
moves.description: Long contexts are split into fixed PARTITION_SIZE chunks. A first kernel writes partial outputs, max_logits and exp_sums; a reduce kernel merges partitions with log-sum-exp-style rescaling.
moves.problem_solved: Improves decode occupancy for small batches and long contexts where one CTA per sequence/head underutilizes the GPU.
semantic_preconditions: partial reductions carry both max logit and exponential sum
partitions exactly span context_len
merge uses the same softmax scale as the partial kernels
hardware_preconditions: extra temporary memory for tmp_out, exp_sums and max_logits
enough CTAs to benefit from split-KV
framework_preconditions: metadata supplies max_num_partitions and scratch tensors
later merge_attn_states consumers pass LSE tensors

assumptions.assumption: PARTITION_SIZE zero disables partitioning
partial softmax state includes max and exp sum
